label: At least one competent ordinary classification can be sustained by overlapping similarity patterns…
paraphrase: OPEN analyst formulation; attribution DEFERRED: At least one competent ordinary classification can be sustained by overlapping similarity patterns among its instances without any one feature in a specified, independently chosen classification-feature vocabulary belonging to every instance. The feature vocabulary is fixed independently of category membership; no claim denies every possible shared property, every disjunctive essence, or common natures for all concepts.
note: Unproved and unestablished. No Lean declaration, source claim or self-evidence marking. The bearing classification and strongest rivals are in docs/wittgenstein.md; existing formal boundaries do not establish this existential philosophical proposition.
